title: 5.10 Ordering Politely 2: At the Market and Shops
unit_outcome: Name food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, talk about meals and prices, and order politely at a café and a market in Spanish.
lesson_title: Ordering Politely 2: At the Market and Shops
sub_lesson_title: Ordering Politely 2: At the Market and Shops
goal: Buy at the market and shops: ¿Me da dos manzanas, por favor? ¿Quiere una bolsa?
grammar_function: ¿Me da + item, por favor? ¿Quiere…? Sí, por favor / No, gracias.
speaking_outcome: Buy at the market and shops: ¿Me da dos manzanas, por favor? ¿Quiere una bolsa?
